observations: A large red heart-shaped form with spiral eyes and an open mouth occupies the center, flanked by two black solid-fill figures with white dot eyes and yellow outline details on a hot-pink ground.
Scattered yellow dash-shapes float across the entire field, overlapping figures and background alike, while diagonal bands of pink, orange, and blue cut behind the central form.
Upper left holds a yellow circular form with black oval markings trailing long yellow lines downward, distinct from the standing figures below it.
reading: Three figures share a pink field without clearly interacting—each holds its own space through contrasting fill colors. The central red form reads as festive or unsettling depending on how its spiral eyes land; the flanking black figures carry white smiles that feel equally ambiguous. Yellow dashes scatter across the surface, refusing to settle into background or foreground. The mood sits somewhere between a parade and unease.
